name: Cineplex full-time student movie tickets
summary: $9 standard 2D tickets, and $8 off-peak discount tickets, for full-time students at Cineplex cinemas.
key: Full-time students pay $9.00 for standard 2D films.
who: Full-time students aged 13 and over with a valid, unexpired student ID card.
catches: No student price for Deluxe sessions.
Off-peak $8 discount tickets are at the cinema's discretion.
